dt: Last LOI deadline Mar 26, 2026 (2027 award year); the 2028 call is not posted yet, expected with LOI registration around March 2027
e: International teams of 2–4 independent PIs from different countries. The US is a member country, and the principal applicant's lab must be in a member country. The Early Career variant requires all members to be within 5 years of independence and 10 years of PhD. The program strongly favors interdisciplinary physics–biology work.
